title: 第1章 金甲神人神目测灵根苏元真君失察变牛马第2章 一座南天门我要吃你三回
slug: 西游平账大圣在我贪亿点咋了
content_zh:
【脑子寄存处，本书所有内容全部虚构，不可能有巧合！
另外，本书不涉及官场，所有内容均为影射公司职场！
“苏大人，我提三个酒。”
“第一个酒，缘分酒。”
“大家都是小千世界飞升上来，有幸认识了苏大人，咱们一起做这个南天门扩建的项目，那就是缘分。”
“都在酒里面，我干了！”
看着对面恭敬地亮出杯底，
苏元也笑着将杯中仙酿一饮而尽，
众人喝彩叫好，气氛愈加热烈。
中间跳舞的宫娥也纷纷回到座位上。
一时间宾主尽欢。
苏元面上春风得意，
小口吃着旁边宫娥夹上来的蛟龙肝，
心中却还在盘算着明日竣工验收的事宜。
一心多用，干到他这个级别，已经是司空见惯了。
【飞升到天庭，在基建处打熬了三千年，我苏元从人仙初期的项目施工员一步步熬到如今的项目副经理（主持工作），并且享受天仙级待遇，终于成了天庭集团的基层干部，这一路走来，吃了多少苦，受了多少罪。
【能否去掉这个“副”
字，成为正天仙级别的领导职务，就看明天竣工验收的情况了。
【信封，我已经装好了，厚度比以往多了三成，天王应该会满意。
【横幅，也让综合办主任准备了，饭后再检查一遍。

【水果，我也托人买了一对三千年的蟠桃，应该也够了。
【明天让项目材料供应商，增长天王的小舅子先去接人，我领着大伙在现场等候。
【见面的开场白该说什么好呢？】
【基建处苏元，觐见敬爱的增长天王？】
【应该用尊敬更为妥当，基建处苏元，觐见尊敬的增长天王！
【要不要这么高调呢？还是简简单单握个手？】
正在犹豫的时候，包间大门被人推开。
苏元眉头下意识蹙起，又缓缓放下。
来人是项目另一位班子成员，总工王鹤。
听闻他与凌霄殿总值王灵官有点远房关系，颇为恃才傲物。
平日里与苏元不甚对付，有时候甚至面子上的工作都懒得做。
王总工快步走到苏元身前，一把拉住他就要往外走。
“苏大人，您怎么还有心思在这吃喝玩乐，快出去看看吧，祸事了！”
【王八蛋，有好事的时候从来不想着我，祸事了来找我分锅？】
苏元心中冷晒，面上却一团和气。
“别急，有话慢慢说。
泰山崩于前而面不改色……”
content_en:
[Brain storage, all contents in this book are fictitious, there can be no coincidence!
In addition, this book does not involve the officialdom, and all the contents are allusions to the corporate workplace!
"Master Su, I'll bring you three drinks."
"The first wine is fate wine."
"We all ascended from the Little Thousand Worlds. We are lucky enough to meet Mr. Su. It is fate that we work on this Nantianmen expansion project together."
"It's all in the wine, I did it!"
Looking at the other side showing the bottom of the cup respectfully,
Su Yuan also smiled and drank the fairy brew in one gulp.
Everyone cheered and the atmosphere became more and more lively.
The palace ladies who were dancing in the middle also returned to their seats.
The guests and hosts enjoyed themselves for a while.
Su Yuan's face was filled with pride,
He ate the dragon's liver served by the palace lady next to him.
But I am still thinking about the completion and acceptance tomorrow.
Multitasking is already commonplace at his level.
[Ascended to Heaven and worked in the infrastructure department for three thousand years. I, Su Yuan, worked my way up step by step from a project constructor in the early stage of human immortality to the current deputy project manager (in charge of work), and enjoyed immortal-level treatment, and finally became a grassroots cadre of Tianting Group. Along the way, I have suffered so much and endured so many sins.
[Can I remove this “vice”?
The word, becoming a leadership position at the level of Zhengtianxian will depend on the completion acceptance tomorrow.
[I have packed the envelope. It is 30% thicker than before. The King of Heaven should be satisfied.
[The banner was also prepared by the director of the General Affairs Office and will be checked again after the meal.
[Fruit, I also asked someone to buy a pair of three-thousand-year-old flat peaches, which should be enough.
[Tomorrow, I will ask the project material supplier and the brother-in-law of the King of Growth to pick them up first. I will lead everyone to wait at the scene.
[What should I say to start a meeting? 】
[Infrastructure Department Su Yuan, meeting the beloved King of Growth? 】
[Respect should be more appropriate, Su Yuan from the Infrastructure Department, meet the respected King of Growth!
【Do you want to be so high-profile? Or simply shake hands? 】
While he was hesitating, the door to the private room was pushed open.
Su Yuan frowned subconsciously, then slowly lowered his eyebrows.
The visitor was another member of the project team, chief engineer Wang He.
I heard that he has a distant relationship with Wang Lingguan, the general manager of Lingxiao Palace, and he is quite proud of his talents.
On weekdays, he doesn't get along very well with Su Yuan, and sometimes he even doesn't bother to do things that look good on him.
Chief Engineer Wang walked quickly to Su Yuan, grabbed him and started to walk out.
"Mr. Su, why are you still thinking about eating, drinking and having fun here? Go out and have a look. It's going to be a disaster!"
[You bastard, you never think about me when good things happen, but come to share the blame with me when bad things happen? 】
Su Yuan felt cold in his heart, but his face was kind.
"Don't be anxious, speak slowly if you have something to say.
Even if Mount Tai collapses in front of you, your face will not change..."
